rules.statement: The block shall meet timing at 50 MHz i_clk (20 ns period) in GF180MCU technology at worst-case corner.
All flip-flops shall be clocked on the rising edge of i_clk and reset asynchronously by i_rst_n.
The RTL shall contain no latches, no clock gating and no derived clocks.
o_cs_n and o_mosi shall be driven directly by flip-flops.
o_sclk shall come from a flip-flop value while o_cs_n = 0.
The only combinational path from an input to o_sclk shall be the i_cpol path, used while o_cs_n = 1 or during reset.
o_sclk should be free of glitches when o_cs_n changes.
The selection between i_cpol and the internal SCLK value should be built so equal inputs give no static hazard.
o_cmd_ready, o_rsp_valid and o_rsp_data shall be driven by flip-flops or logic of flip-flops only, with no combinational path from any input.
i_miso shall be captured directly into a data flip-flop with no synchroniser.
The integrator shall constrain the input delay of i_miso.
The half-period counter shall be wide enough for D = 255, at least 8 bits.
